title: 2001 HMMT February Guts Problem 3
statement: Find the number of triangulations of a general convex 7 -gon into 5 triangles by 4 diagonals that do not intersect in their interiors.

solutions.text: Define the Catalan numbers by \(C(n)=\frac{1}{n+1}\binom{2 n}{n}\). The current solution is the \(C(\) number of triangles \()=C(5)=42\).
